Delhi Park Safety Audit Ordered After Kalka Ji Gangrape Case

Following a gangrape incident in Kalka Ji, Delhi's Lieutenant Governor (LG) has ordered a safety audit of all parks in the city. A report on the audit has been requested within one week. The incident has raised questions about the law and order situation in Delhi.
